**Works from launchers.** Launchers such as Doom Runner start the game with
paths relative to its folder, like `..\..\Game IWADs\DOOM2.WAD`. DERP moved
to its save folder before opening them, so the game stopped with "Not a
valid game IWAD". The IWAD, add-on files, DEHACKED patches, config file,
SoundFont and demo recording paths now work however the launcher writes
them. In Doom Runner, pick the PrBoom engine family and point the data
directory at `%APPDATA%\Local Games\DOOM` to see DERP's saves.
